The '''Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] launched by the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that occurred in [[11,198 BBY]]. The Republic launched forces from [[Masterra|Ord Masterra]] against [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]&mdash;the homeworld of the secretive [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]&mdash;and from [[Ord Dycoll]] against the warmongering [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lanniks]] of [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade first appeared in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', on a map of several of the crusades.<ref name="EGW" />
